svg.font-family: "Helvetica Neue","Segoe UI","Liberation Sans",Arial,sans-serif,"Hiragino Sans","Noto Sans JP","Yu Gothic","Meiryo","IPAPGothic",sans-serif
svg.title: Wave lines receding to a horizon
svg.desc: 32 noise-displaced lines, crowded and calm at the horizon and wider and heavier toward the viewer, suggest the surface of a bay. They are decoration, not a measured waveform.
